name: two_shaft_gas_turbine_compressor_map
title: Two-shaft gas turbine with a compressor map and two expanders
summary: Steady-state model of a two-shaft gas turbine (single-spool compressor and combustor, two mechanically independent expanders) on air: the compressor is described by a performance map (reduced flow, pressure ratio and isentropic efficiency versus reduced speed), the combustor by an energy balance with the mean specific heats of the ULiege combustion library, and expander 1 by a power balance from which its isentropic efficiency is found. Revision exercise of the ULiege course 'Machines et systemes thermiques', in three parts.
language_features: INTERPOLATE (native EES call form with a named argument)
user-library routines cpbar and gamma (implicit library, copied in the runnable variants)

origin.course: MECA0006 Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), revision exercises of 2005-12-23, part 2

verification.reference: EES stored solutions of the three files of the revision exercise: TM-0150 (main file, nominal speed), TM-0151 (ambient variant, 0.76 bar and 0 °C) and TM-0149 (95 % speed, t_ex_burner and epsilon_s_exp1 given), compared with tools/compare_solution.py
verification.notes: 40 of the 44 EES variables agree within 1.6e-3 relative (largest: the mean specific heat of air, 1.6e-3); all derived results (powers, temperatures, efficiency, flows) within 1.1e-3. h_1, h_2, h_2s and s_1 differ by CoolProp's reference state for air; their differences agree to 6e-4. Same deviations for the ambient variant (max 1.4e-3) and for the 95 % speed case.

history.action: added (roadmap card C-10, duplicate group DG-0032: TM-0150 representative, TM-0149 and TM-0151 merged, TM-0175/76/77 byte-identical duplicates)
